titulo: Quick sort: the worst case matters
enunciado: Count the comparisons of quick sort (pivot = last element) with n = 60 on a shuffled permutation and on an already sorted input. Explain why sorted input makes it O(n²) and compare with n(n-1)/2.
objetivos: Understand that average and worst case can differ a lot
pistas: With sorted data, the last element is always the maximum.
Then each partition leaves n - 1 elements on one side and 0 on the other.
Choosing a random pivot or the median of three avoids that case.
